photos.caption: The day everything changed
photos.memory: I remember this moment like it was yesterday. The way you smiled made me forget everything else in the world.

photos.caption: My favorite adventure with you
photos.memory: We laughed so much that day. I knew then that every adventure is better when you're beside me.

photos.caption: Just the two of us
photos.memory: No filters, no plans — just us being completely ourselves. This is my favorite kind of day.

photos.caption: You & your beautiful smile
photos.memory: I took this photo because I never want to forget the way you look when you're genuinely happy.

photos.caption: The little moments
photos.memory: It's the small moments like this one that I treasure the most. With you, ordinary becomes extraordinary.

photos.caption: My whole world
photos.memory: This photo says everything I never know how to put into words. You are my everything.
